title: One job in Chicago with Freddie Keppard and Roy Palmer
summary: He played one Chicago job with Freddie Keppard's band, with Roy Palmer on trombone, and worked at the Dreamland before joining Tiny Parham.

story.theme_name: Chicago: the jazz migration and its clubs
story.community_name: Going north: working the Chicago jazz scene

blocks.x: What do you want to tell us, you played a couple of jobs with Roy Palmer.
Yeah, well, no, one job. One job. Yeah, one job in Chicago. What was the band?
Who was the band? Freddie Kepler. He used the two trumpets, trombone, you know, rhythm. And Roy Palmer was on trombone with us. Clarinet Flats or sax?
Yeah, they used to have one.
Chillin' Alto and Clarinet, but I can't think of who the guys was, no. Yeah. Yeah.

Kepler had a good size band? Yeah. I worked at the Dream Land with him about three years before I got good. Well, I mean, when I first hit Chicago, he picked me up, see. Picked me up. He was right there.
Freddie Kepler was working at the Dream Land. All I had to do come to Vindum, the Vindum was set to this block, right across the street to the next block on State Street.
That was before you were with Tiny?
Oh, yeah, that's before I was with Tiny, yeah.
